body: As I pick up the slammed request slip, my mind racing with indignation, I notice the stamp stamped on the front with bold red letters: "Request Refused." A smirk forms on my face as I think about the audacity of the archivist, who clearly did not understand the value of a genuine request. I feel my instincts stirring, urging me to take a stand and let the archivist know that their behavior will not be tolerated.
